name: GradeControlSampleTracker
tagline: From sample bag to released dig block – lab batches, QAQC and ore/waste release in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete grade control app for mines: register grade control samples, build lab dispatch batches with CRM standards, blanks and duplicates, enter assay results, check QAQC with control charts and duplicate precision, and classify and release dig blocks as ore or waste – with every chain-of-custody rule enforced.
features: Sample lifecycle Collected → Dispatched → At lab → Assayed → Validated with Re-assay and Rejected
Dispatch batches from selected samples with QC insertion, CRM and blank checks
Minimum sample mass rule before dispatch
Batch result entry grid with validation
CRM control charts (±2 / ±3 SD), blank chart, field and lab duplicate HARD % scatter
Failed QAQC blocks batch acceptance; re-assay with reason
Dig block mean grade (mass-weighted), suggested class from configurable cut-offs
Classification override with reason, release by geologist, mined and on hold
Undo, confirmations, CSV export, bulk actions
Desktop, tablet and phone layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
Power Fx outputs and events incl. ChangedRecordsJson
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
